name: request-list
title: Information we still need
for_each: select distinct j.id,j.name from jobs j join requests q on q.job_id=j.id where q.status='open'

sections.title: Job
sections.sql: select name as job,client,period_end,due_on,manager from v_jobs where id=$1

sections.title: Outstanding
sections.sql: select item,requested_on,due_on from requests where job_id=$1 and status='open' order by due_on
sections.note: Reply with the files attached, or upload them where your accountant has asked. Items already received are not listed.

name: document-register
title: Client document register
for_each: select id,name from clients where id in (select client_id from documents)

sections.title: Client
sections.sql: select c.code,c.name,c.entity,c.country,p.name as partner from clients c left join staff p on p.id=c.partner_id where c.id=$1

sections.title: Documents held
sections.sql: select year,category,title,kind,doc_date,retain_until,path from v_documents where client_id=$1 and status='final' order by year desc nulls last,category,title
sections.note: An index of what the practice holds. The files live at the path shown.

sections.title: Disposed of on schedule
sections.sql: select d.title,x.retain_until,x.disposed_on,x.authorised_by from disposals x join documents d on d.id=x.document_id where d.client_id=$1 order by x.disposed_on

name: job-file
title: Job file summary for quality review
for_each: select id,name from jobs where state in ('lodged','complete','signing')

sections.title: Job
sections.sql: select name as job,client,job_type,service,state,period_end,lodged_on,manager,partner from v_jobs where id=$1

sections.title: Required documents
sections.sql: select category,filed,final from v_checklist where job_id=$1 order by category

sections.title: Documents on file
sections.sql: select category,title,status,doc_date,sha256 from v_documents where job_id=$1 and status<>'disposed' order by category,doc_date

sections.title: Signatures
sections.sql: select title,signer,method,sent_on,signed_on from v_signatures where document_id in (select id from documents where job_id=$1)

name: disposal-certificate
title: Record of disposal
for_each: select x.id,d.title as name from disposals x join documents d on d.id=x.document_id

sections.title: Document
sections.sql: select c.name as client,d.title,cat.name as category,d.doc_date,d.path,d.sha256 from disposals x join documents d on d.id=x.document_id left join clients c on c.id=d.client_id left join categories cat on cat.id=d.category_id where x.id=$1

sections.title: Disposal
sections.note: Disposed of after the retention period shown, with no hold in place at the time.
